episodes.description: Welcome to the Saturday Examen. This week’s readings have circled repeatedly around the themes of seeing rightly and reaching out in trust. On Monday, a man with a withered hand was asked to stretch it out before he knew whether healing would come. On Tuesday, Joseph said yes to something he did not understand, trusting a word given to him in sleep. Where this week have you been asked to act in trust before being certain of the outcome?
